purpose: wrapUpのAFTER。いま：同じカウンターの奥に、特定された写真が展示され、まちの記録になった
scene: The SAME library counter, from the SAME camera: the wooden counter, the green desk lamp at its left end and the tall bookshelf wall are UNCHANGED. composition: Identical framing to the BEFORE: same counter, same green lamp, same bookshelf wall. Change ONLY: the framed sepia photo with blank caption card on the wall, the child, the smiles, the potted flower.
